claim: a(13) >= 9: no covering 8-triple-system of {1..13} forces a mono triple (conjecture bound 9 -> INFEASIBLE expected at k=8)
proof_scope: case split: (a) Fano-containing systems cover at most 7 + 3*1 = 10 < 13 vertices, violating coverage of {1..13}, so they are excluded by counting without search; (b) this model encodes the Fano-free subcase exactly (30 nogoods per 7-subset, one per distinct Fano plane).  INFEASIBLE of (b) + the counting exclusion of (a) proves no covering 8-triple system of {1..13} forces a mono triple.
